title: Rules for residence
reading: An immigrant is a person who was born abroad, but lives in Norway. Immigrants in Norway have different residence permits and different rights.

Immigrants from EU/EEA countries can work in Norway without applying for a residence permit, but they must register with the police. This is done digitally. Resettlement refugees or quota refugees come to Norway in agreement with the UNHCR (UN). They receive a temporary residence permit when they come to Norway. A person who is persecuted in their home country because of race, religion, nationality, sexual orientation or political work, can be granted asylum in Norway. Asylum seekers come to Norway themselves and apply for asylum. Their application can be rejected or they can be granted asylum/residence on grounds of strong humanitarian considerations. Family members of persons with a residence permit in Norway can apply for family reunification.
Persons who have been granted asylum/residence on grounds of strong humanitarian considerations, and resettlement refugees, are known as refugees.
discussion: Talk together Who decides who gets to stay in a country? Can everybody who wants to, move to your home country? Why doesn’t everyone who wants a residence permit in Norway get one? What responsibility does a country have to receive refugees, and what responsibility do refugees themselves have?
exercises: Select the right answer What does the word immigrant mean? Someone born outside Norway, but who lives in Norway. Someone who has two parents born outside Norway. Someone who has one parent born outside Norway. Select the right answer Can people from EU/EEA countries work in Norway without applying for a residence permit? No, everyone has to apply for a residence permit to work in Norway. Yes, but they have to register with the police. If they are from Scandinavia, they can work without a residence permit. Select the right answer On which website can you fill in information and receive customised guidance in residence cases? www.skatteetaten.no www.udi.no www.nrk.no Select the right answer What can the family members of a person with a residence permit in Norway apply for? family support family reunification family benefit Select right or wrong Read the statements. What is right? What is wrong? Immigrants in Norway have the same residence permit and the same rights. Right Wrong Asylum seekers’ applications can be rejected or they can be granted asylum/residence on grounds of strong humanitarian considerations. Right Wrong People are granted a temporary residence permit for their first three or five years in Norway, which is normally renewed every year. Right Wrong People from EU/EEA countries must apply for a residence permit to work in Norway. Right Wrong People who are persecuted in their home country because of ethnicity, religion, nationality, sexual orientation or political work, can be granted asylum in Norway. Right Wrong
teacher_notes: Lærerinnhold Tips til undervisningen Snakk sammen Hvem som får bo i et land er et politisk spørsmål. Innvandring og mottak av flyktninger er et av de mest debatterte temaene i norsk politikk, med mange sprikende og sterke meninger. Meningene kan for eksempel være basert på økonomi, kulturspørsmål, redsel for det ukjente, rettferdighet eller integreringsspørsmål. Norge er i tillegg  bundet av internasjonale avtaler og traktater som handler om innvandring. Når et land tar imot flyktninger, sier man også ja til ansvar og forpliktelse. I Norge får flyktninger tilbud om introduksjonsprogram. Gjennom introduksjonsprogrammet får flyktningen mulighet til å kvalifisere seg for arbeid og mottar også en introduksjonsstøtte i en periode. Til gjengjeld forventes det at flyktningene selv skal gjøre en innsats blant annet for å lære seg språket, tilpasse seg kulturen og komme i arbeid. Innvandring og kor mange flyktningar vi skal ta imot er eit av temaa det er mest debatt om i norsk politikk, og her er mange sprikande og sterke meiningar. Meiningane kan til dømes vere baserte på økonomi, kulturspørsmål, redsle for det ukjende, rettvise eller integreringsspørsmål. Noreg er dessutan bunde av internasjonale avtalar og traktatar som handlar om innvandring. Når eit land tek imot flyktningar, seier ein òg ja til ansvar og plikter. Flyktningar som kjem til Noreg, får tilbod om eit introduksjonsprogram. Dette introduksjonsprogrammet gjev flyktningar ei moglegheit til å kvalifisere seg for arbeid, og dei får òg introduksjonsstønad i ein periode. Til gjengjeld blir det venta av flyktningane at dei sjølve skal gjere ein innsats, mellom anna for å lære seg språket, tilpasse seg til kulturen og kome i arbeid.
